agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Commission for the Arts
AGENDA
APRIL 6, 2015 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the Commission Secretary. If at least two Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
4.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
5.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES OF THE MARCH 2, 2015 MEETING.
Approve the Minutes.
6.
ACTION ITEMS - OLD BUSINESS
6A.
Review Public Art Ad Hoc Committee Recommendations for MacKinnon Overpass. Contact Person: Commissioner Lueker.
Vote to approve recommendations.
7.
ACTION ITEMS - NEW BUSINESS
7A.
Appoint a Commissioner to serve on the Community Grant Program Evaluation Panel. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam
Vote to appoint a Commissioner.
7B.
Appoint a Commissioner to serve on the Artwork Selection Panel for the Environmental Commission's Environmental Award. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam
Vote to appoint a Commissioner.
7C.
Update the Work Plan Ad Hoc Committee assignments and make new appointments.
Vote to appoint Commissioners.
7D.
Vote to appoint a commissioner to serve as Chair and Vice Chair of the Commission.
Vote to appoint Commissioners.
8.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
8A.
Encinitas Arts Festival review. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam.
8B.
Encinitas Friends of the Arts report. Contact Person: Commissioner Tanha.
8C.
Pacific View Activation Plan report. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam.
8D.
Ballet Folklorico de San Dieguito report. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam.
8E.
Encinitas Student Film Festival. Contact Person: Commissioner Filsinger.
8F.
Sculpture Garden discussion. Contact Person: Commissioner Sabeck.
8G.
Commission-sponsored and Co-sponsored Events:
Wednesdays@Noon concerts, April 1, 8, 15, 22, 29, Encinitas Library
Music by the Sea concert, April 17, 7:30pm, Encinitas Library
Opening Reception: San Dieguito Art Guild, April 4, 1-4pm, Community Center
9.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
10.
COMMISSIONERS' REPORTS
11.
